chapters.title: Chapter 5 - A Deal with a Devil
1.	The Basement – Introduction to the immersive video game world and Alex's team.
2.	Into the Unknown – Alex unlocks a mysterious mission and begins questioning reality.
3.	The Unraveling – The true purpose of War Games is revealed, and the team learns they are fighting real battles.
4.	Cracks in Reality – Alex and his friends face consequences as they try to uncover who is behind the game.
5.	Countdown to Invasion – The group learns of an impending alien invasion on Earth.
6.	Into the Warzone – The team is transported into real combat, facing grotesque alien creatures.
7.	Into the Alien Ships – Alex battles aboard alien vessels, facing shape-shifting foes.
8.	The Shape-Shifting War – The team learns shape-shifting to combat alien adversaries.
9.	The Giant’s Challenge – Tyrakus, a giant mentor, begins their intensive combat and transformation training.
10.	The Path of Mastery – Lila’s leadership and the team’s skills in mind control and shape-shifting develop.
11.	The Weapons of the World – The team is introduced to powerful, sentient weapons on an alien planet.
12.	The Leader They Never Knew They Needed – Lila emerges as the leader; the team discovers a futuristic Earth.
13.	The Protectors Rise – The team navigates the conflict between the Reepers and Believers on future Earth.
